citations.assessment: Abba Yose ben Yochanan is named in the incense preparation instruction.
The checked witness reads Abba Isi ben Yochanan transmitting in the name of Shmuel HaKatan. Keep Heilprin’s shortened Isi form.
The baraita names this Abba Yose ben Yochanan of Jerusalem quoting Rabbi Meir and the discussion has the shorter ben Chanan form.
